archivist.name: Archivist
archivist.description:
CAREER + SPECIALIZATION POWERS: Influence, Move, Manipulate, and Psychometry.

The Archivist is the Force Librarian. They are Knowledge of the Force and different force culture, and history.

field_agent.name: Field Agent
field_agent.description: The field agent is the jack-of-all-trades spy that operates in the field, often sent to investigate and infiltrate a situation socially. While a decent combatant, they mostly talk their way out of problems and resort to fisticuffs and light concealable weapons.

nerf_herder.name: Nerf Herder
nerf_herder.description: The Nerf herder is the animal husbandry maximalist, and the outdoors person who can shepherd a flock of animals in the most inhospitable situations.
